title: MVE Academy
subtitle: Minimum Viable Engineer — a course for PMs who need to ship.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Infrastructure
phases.miniBuild: A project folder, committed to GitHub. Your first real repo.

phases.title: Phase 2 — The Language Layer
phases.miniBuild: A Node script that calls a free API and prints results to your terminal.

phases.title: Phase 3 — The Web Layer
phases.miniBuild: A working local web app that reads from an API and shows data on screen.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Directing Claude
phases.miniBuild: You spec and ship a small feature using only Claude as your dev.

phases.title: Phase 5 — Shipping
phases.miniBuild: Something real. Live on the internet.

m0.title: Environment Setup
m0.desc: iTerm2, Homebrew, verify everything works. Day zero.

m1.title: Terminal Fundamentals
m1.desc: Navigation, files, processes, paths, errors, environment.

m2.title: VS Code
m2.desc: Setup, extensions, integrated terminal, basic editing workflow.

m3.title: Git & GitHub
m3.desc: Version control, commits, branches, push/pull, .gitignore. Why this is non-negotiable.

m4.title: JavaScript for Directors
m4.desc: Read it, don't write it. Variables, functions, objects, arrays, async/await.

m5.title: Node.js & npm
m5.desc: How code runs outside the browser. Require, scripts, package.json.

m6.title: JSON
m6.desc: Structure, parsing, writing. The format everything on the web is built on.

m7.title: APIs & HTTP
m7.desc: Requests, responses, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, status codes, headers.

m8.title: React Basics
m8.desc: Components, props, state, hooks. Enough to read and direct.

m9.title: Reading Documentation
m9.desc: How to navigate API docs, find examples, and extract what you need.

m10.title: Debugging Without Panicking
m10.desc: Reading errors, isolating problems, describing issues to Claude so it actually helps.

m11.title: Prompting for Engineers
m11.desc: Context, constraints, iteration. The skill that makes this whole thing work.

m12.title: First Real Build
m12.desc: End-to-end: prompt → code → run → debug → working app. This is what everything was for.

m13.title: Deployment
m13.desc: Vercel or Railway, environment variables in production, getting a URL you can share.

m14.title: Integrations & Webhooks
m14.desc: Two services talking to each other automatically. Event-driven architecture basics.

m15.title: Capstone — Ship Something Real
m15.desc: Live on the internet. TBD once you pick your project.
